newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks ease in London as HSBC, FTSE ease.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks ease in London as HSBC, FTSE ease.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks were slightly weaker in London in late afternoon trading on Friday, dragged down by losses in HSBC Holdings and a 0.70 percent drop in the UK's FTSE 100 share index, dealers said.
At 1426 GMT, the Hang Seng London Reference index was down 62.94 points to 15,133.85.
HSBC shares were trading around HK$231.25 in London, down from their Hong Kong closing level of HK$233.
Dealers said trade was further dampened by an impending long weekend in Hong Kong. China takes over the wealthy territory on July 1.
The Hang Seng Index rose 68.77 points in Hong Kong to a record 15,196.79.
